metadata.question: Did the total water surface area within a 5 km radius of Agudo, Brazil increase between November 5, 2023 and November 21, 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 SR (primary) within 5 km of Agudo, Brazil (Point: -29.644, -53.252) for two windows bracketing the dates: 2023-11-01..2023-11-09 (Nov 5) and 2023-11-17..2023-11-25 (Nov 21). If empty, fallback to Landsat 8/9 SR L2.
2. Masking strategy: For S2, mask clouds using QA60 bits 10/11 and compute NDWI from median of B3 (green) and B8 (NIR). For Landsat, mask QA_PIXEL (cloud, shadow, snow, cirrus), scale SR, NDWI from B3/B5. Classify water as NDWI > 0.3. Compute area via pixelArea masked to water. Count valid pixels; estimate cloud % = 1 - valid/total.
3. Validity checks: If collections empty → C1. If valid pixel count after masking is 0 → C2. If area is null or > region area by 5% → C3. Otherwise compare areas: increase → A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  const ev = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate((v, e) => e ? reject(e) : resolve(v)));
  const geomPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-53.252, -29.644]); // Agudo, RS, Brazil (approx.)
  const region = geomPoint.buffer(5000); // 5 km radius
  const scale = 1000; // per requirement
  const regionAreaM2 = await ev(ee.Image.pixelArea().reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true
  }).get('area'));
  const regionAreaKm2 = regionAreaM2 ? regionAreaM2 / 1e6 : null;

  function s2Mask(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA60');
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).neq(0).or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).neq(0));
    return img.updateMask(cloud.not());
  }
  function l2MaskScale(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<3).eq(0) // cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<4).eq(0))      // cloud shadow
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<5).eq(0))      // snow
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<2).eq(0));     // cirrus
    const sr = img.select(['SR_B3','SR_B5']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    return sr.updateMask(mask);
  }
  async function computeWindow(startStr, endStr) {
    const start = ee.Date(startStr); const end = ee.Date(endStr);
    let dataset = 'S2';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
      .filterBounds(region).filterDate(start, end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 60));
    let size = await ev(col.size());
    if ((size||0) === 0) {
      dataset = 'L8/9';
      const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2');
      const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2');
      col = l8.merge(l9).filterBounds(region).filterDate(start, end);
      size = await ev(col.size());
      if ((size||0) === 0) {
        return {code:'C1', line:`${startStr}..${endStr} | Dataset: none | Images: 0`};
      }
    }
    let median;
    if (dataset === 'S2') {
      median = col.map(s2Mask).select(['B3','B8']).median().rename(['G','NIR']);
    } else {
      median = col.map(l2MaskScale).rename(['G','NIR']).median();
    }
    const ndwi = median.normalizedDifference(['G','NIR']).rename('NDWI');
    const totalPx = await ev(ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true
    }).get('one')) || 0;
    const validPx = await ev(ndwi.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true
    }).get('NDWI')) || 0;
    if (validPx === 0) {
      return {code:'C2', line:`${startStr}..${endStr} | Dataset: ${dataset} | Images: ${size} | ValidPx: 0/${totalPx}`};
    }
    const cloudPct = totalPx > 0 ? (100 * (1 - validPx/totalPx)) : null;
    const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0.3);
    const waterAreaM2 = await ev(ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(waterMask).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true
    }).get('area'));
    if (waterAreaM2 === null || waterAreaM2 === undefined || regionAreaM2 === null) {
      return {code:'C3', line:`${startStr}..${endStr} | Dataset: ${dataset} | Images: ${size} | Calc: null`};
    }
    if (waterAreaM2 < 0 || waterAreaM2 > regionAreaM2 * 1.05) {
      return {code:'C3', line:`${startStr}..${endStr} | Dataset: ${dataset} | Images: ${size} | Area out of range`};
    }
    const line = `${startStr}..${endStr} | Dataset: ${dataset} | Images: ${size} | ValidPx: ${validPx}/${totalPx} | Cloud: ${cloudPct !== null ? cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}% | Water_km2: ${(waterAreaM2/1e6).toFixed(3)}`;
    return {code:null, dataset, size, validPx, totalPx, cloudPct, waterAreaM2, line};
  }

  try {
    console.log(`Region: Agudo, Brazil | Buffer: 5 km | Area_km2: ${regionAreaKm2 !== null ? regionAreaKm2.toFixed(3) : 'NA'}`);
    const w1 = await computeWindow('2023-11-01', '2023-11-09');
    console.log(`W1 ${w1.line}`);
    const w2 = await computeWindow('2023-11-17', '2023-11-25');
    console.log(`W2 ${w2.line}`);

    if (w1.code === 'C1' || w2.code === 'C1') { console.log('C1'); return; }
    if (w1.code === 'C2' || w2.code === 'C2') { console.log('C2'); return; }
    if (w1.code === 'C3' || w2.code === 'C3') { console.log('C3'); return; }

    const a1 = w1.waterAreaM2 / 1e6;
    const a2 = w2.waterAreaM2 / 1e6;
    const diff = a2 - a1;
    console.log(`Change_km2: ${diff.toFixed(3)}`);
    const tol = 0.001; // ~0.001 km2 tolerance
    if (!isFinite(diff)) { console.log('C3'); return; }
    console.log(diff > tol ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
